summary:
Sabotix is a space mission game for all participants that provides facts about space and technology. It contains three space missions-Moon Landing, Exo planet and Communication with space.
It is an interactive web game where space facts are provided to enlighten young minds.
details: Its working is really simple as a game, you enter the spacecraft after customizing your avatar then you have the option to select the mission among the ones provided, then after overcoming the obstacles provided you will complete the mission and reach the destination. The impact of our project is to deliver space facts and related information to others in a fun interactive way through a game. As a web game the language used are HTML and CSS. The benefits of Sabotix is anyone can manage and design a spacecraft and conduct space missions provided through which they get to know interesting facts of that particular mission.
